gateway: isolated temporary home, approval=reads; a freshly seeded gateway for the stub screenshots, one for the live ones and one for the walkthrough
data: fictional, seeded through the app's HTTP API (capture/scenes.json)

agent_backend.live_model: the operator's own installed, signed-in kiro-cli over ACP with model "auto"; the replies on screen are that model's and vary from run to run
agent_backend.stub: Kiro Crew's offline stub ACP backend (capture/stub_backend.py) for every other scene; no chat reply is shown from it
agent_backend.credit_reading: the browser answers the top bar's credit readout (/api/sessions/usage) with "no reading", so no account balance or email can be shown

note: The isolated gateway served this repository's own copy of the app: capture.py's setup installed it from this checkout (POST /api/apps/install), trusted it and enabled it, and every picture shows its committed bundle (ui/dist/index.mjs) and backend. Kiro Crew still ships a built-in design-critique and refuses a second install under the same name, so the Kiro Crew tree the capture ran on is that release's App Kit level-1 commit with only the built-in copy removed (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/design_critique and its BUILTIN_NAMES row); kirocrew_tree_dirty records that.
data_notes: The screens the critic reads are fictional mockups of a made-up library app (Fernleaf Library), written for this README as HTML and rendered to PNG (capture/fixtures/). Every name, card number and the .example email address in them is invented.
They are handed to the page's own file picker, exactly as choosing them in the browser would; the page uploads them through the dashboard's upload endpoint.
Every critique and the follow-up answer came from a live model, so the wording, the findings and their count differ from run to run.

walkthrough.alt: A walkthrough of Design Critique: four screens of a library hold flow are added in order, Critique this flow starts the run, the report appears with an overall read, What's working and an Across the flow finding about key facts set in very faint grey text, and choosing step 3 shows the Pick-up screen with its numbered pins
